purpose: How a source's soil moisture reaches a land surface model whose soil hydraulics differ. Each source's soil model is a row here, never a code path. Defect it fixes: an ERA5 start copied HTESSEL soil moisture straight into RUC (top level 0.36 against HRRR's RUC 0.21 at the same cells), so latent heat took the sun and T2 ran 1-2 C cold from the first hour with no storms (found 2026-10-26, Oklahoma 2024-05-06 18Z).

htessel.description: ECMWF HTESSEL (ERA5, IFS): four layers 0-7, 7-28, 28-100, 100-289 cm.

noah.description: Noah / Noah-MP family (GFS, GEFS, GDAS, CFS, NAM; WRF Noah and Noah-MP): four layers 0-10, 10-40, 40-100, 100-200 cm.

ruc.description: RUC LSM (HRRR, RAP, RRFS): nine nodes 0, 1, 4, 10, 30, 60, 100, 160, 300 cm.

copy_pairs.rule: copy the source moisture unchanged (stock WRF real.exe, gpuwm 2.9.8 and earlier)
copy_pairs.evidence: WOOF NYC 750 m city template (YSU, MM5 surface layer, Noah), HRRR 2026-10-28 12Z, 9 h replay on gpuwm 2.9.9 against 27 ASOS stations. The index remap took Noah's top layer on natural land from 0.150 to 0.106 (RUC wilting points sit above Noah's), latent heat on natural land fell to 40 W/m2 at +4 h against HRRR's 67, and 2 m dew point f04-09 ran -1.74 F against ASOS (rural -1.85, HRRR +0.50). Copying gave 54 W/m2, dew point f04-09 -1.41 F (rural -1.05), dew point RMSE f01-09 3.63 -> 3.45 F, 2 m T RMSE 2.09 -> 2.02 F. Report: WOOF-OPS/noah-city-first-hour-2026-10-29.
copy_pairs.why: The index remap was measured only for HTESSEL into RUC. RUC into Noah has no evidence for it and scores worse against observations.

htessel.citation: IFS Documentation Cy47r3 Part IV (Physical processes), Table 8.9: van Genuchten soil classes of HTESSEL (Balsamo et al. 2009, J. Hydrometeor. 10, 623-643). Field capacity at -0.33 bar, permanent wilting point at -15 bar.

class_from_stas.comment: The target grid's own 16-class STAS (USDA) texture, assigned to the FAO texture class HTESSEL uses by the FAO class limits (coarse: clay < 18 % and sand > 65 %; medium: clay 18-35 % with sand > 15 %, or clay < 18 % with sand 15-65 %; medium fine: clay < 35 % and sand < 15 %; fine: clay 35-60 %; very fine: clay > 60 %) at each USDA class's centroid. The source cell's moisture index is formed with the source model's hydraulics for the soil at the point; the horizontal texture structure is the separate soil_downscale step.

donors.description: HRRR's own cycled RUC soil analysis (wrfprs f00, TSOIL/SOILW at the nine RUC nodes) on the HRRR CONUS grid, from the NOAA HRRR archive on AWS.

coverage_box.comment: lat/lon box around the HRRR CONUS grid corners (21.14N 122.72W, 47.84N 134.10W, 47.84N 60.92W, 21.14N 72.43W); a domain with no point inside is not fetched for
